setup.title: One Canvas, Many Places
setup.style: Live-action, cinematic travel film with natural light and rich landscapes across the seasons; the same canvas travels with the painter and keeps every element she has painted; one continuous shot per prompt.

cast.name: Elena
cast.description: Elena, a painter in her fifties with silver hair in a loose bun, round tortoiseshell glasses, a mustard-yellow knit sweater, olive canvas trousers and a paint-stained brown leather satchel.

cast.name: the canvas
cast.description: the canvas, one large landscape canvas on a wooden field easel, which Elena carries from place to place and paints a little more at each stop.

extras.music: Gentle solo piano with soft strings, warm and unhurried.
extras.voice: Elena, speaking in voice-over, a woman in her fifties with a warm, soft and thoughtful voice and a light Italian accent (S1),

shots.prompt: A medium shot of a sunlit painting studio, where Elena stands beside a large blank white canvas. Elena, a painter with silver hair in a loose bun, round tortoiseshell glasses and a mustard-yellow knit sweater, folds a wooden field easel, tucks brushes and paint tubes into her brown leather satchel and lifts the blank white canvas under her arm. The camera holds a medium shot by the studio window.

variants.h3:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium shot of a sunlit painting studio, where Elena stands beside a large blank white canvas. Elena, a painter with silver hair in a loose bun, round tortoiseshell glasses and a mustard-yellow knit sweater, folds a wooden field easel, tucks brushes and paint tubes into her brown leather satchel and lifts the blank white canvas under her arm. The camera holds a medium shot by the studio window. Elena, speaking in voice-over, a woman in her fifties with a warm, soft and thoughtful voice and a light Italian accent (S1), says: <d>[English] One canvas, and every place I visit goes into it.</d> After this line the voice-over stays silent for the rest of the shot.

overall_soundscape: Brushes rattling into the satchel, the creak of the folding easel and birds outside.

non_diegetic_music: Gentle solo piano with soft strings, warm and unhurried.

shots.prompt: A medium shot inside a train carriage in morning light, where Elena sits by the window. Elena, a painter with silver hair in a loose bun, round tortoiseshell glasses and a mustard-yellow knit sweater, sketches the passing green valleys in a small notebook with a pencil. The blank white canvas and the folded wooden easel lean against the seat beside her. The camera holds a medium shot from the opposite seat, the landscape streaming past the window.

shots.prompt: A wide shot of a mountain lake at sunrise, where Elena paints at her easel on the rocky shore. Elena, a painter with silver hair in a loose bun, round tortoiseshell glasses and a mustard-yellow knit sweater, paints jagged snowy mountain peaks across the top of the canvas, with a turquoise lake beneath them, matching the real peaks glowing pink and gold across the water. The rest of the canvas is still blank white. The camera holds a wide shot with the real mountains behind the canvas.

shots.prompt: A medium shot of the same lakeshore later in the morning, where Elena adds a detail to the canvas. A small red wooden rowboat drifts on the real lake. Elena, a painter with silver hair in a loose bun, round tortoiseshell glasses and a mustard-yellow knit sweater, paints a tiny red rowboat onto the turquoise lake of her canvas. The canvas shows the snowy peaks and the turquoise lake with the little red boat at the top; the lower half is still blank white. The camera looks over her shoulder at the canvas, with the real boat soft in the background.
